requirements.question: Which watched satellites in LEO, MEO, HEO, or GEO are executing non-routine orbital maneuvers, co-orbital approaches, or new multi-object deployments?
Which watched payloads have executed an in-track, cross-track, or radial maneuver exceeding station-keeping thresholds (delta_v >= 1.5 m/s or calibrated confidence >= 0.75) in the past 30 days?
Which new launches, subsatellite deployments, or unnumbered active objects have entered the GCAT/CelesTrak catalogs?
What is the maneuver type (in-track, cross-track, radial), estimated delta-v (m/s), and sibling-launch context for the maneuvering object?
Does the watched satellite have a TLE tracking gap >=48 hours that degrades maneuver detection confidence?
